name: SANCAGNA
description: Sancagna is a four-player point-trick game using a 52-card Venetian pack, played on Burano in the Venice lagoon. Two teams of two (partners opposite) play anticlockwise; trump is determined by a turned card. Players must follow suit or play trump. The aim is to be the first team to collect 21 or more card points in tricks won; excess points carry to the next game.

items.text: Six-player Sancagna: Six players in two teams of three, each player between two opponents. Four cards dealt to each; if neither team has gone out by end of fourth trick, another four cards each are dealt.
Two-player Sancagna: Two players. Deal six cards each in packets of three (as in four-player). Up to three further deals from the same deck if neither player has gone out.
